question: What should a centralized clustering enabled STA do if it receives a DMG Beacon frame from a member AP of another ECAPC? [IEEE 802.11]
options: Continue and become an S-AP in the CCSS
Join the cluster of the S-AP as a member AP or member PCP
Cease its activity on this channel
Attempt operation on a different channel
Unenroll from its current CCSS
correct_answer: Join the cluster of the S-AP as a member AP or member PCP

question: What is the principle for the long term evolution of the IM CN subsystem? [3GPP Release 18]
options: It is restricted by the short/mid-term inter-domain roaming requirements.
It is not restricted by the short/mid-term inter-domain roaming requirements.
It is dependent on the subscription options in the visited network.
It is dependent on the subscription options in the home environment.
It is restricted by the capabilities of the visited network.
correct_answer: It is not restricted by the short/mid-term inter-domain roaming requirements.

question: Which protocol is recommended to use instead of Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) according to IEEE standards? [IEEE 802.3]
options: Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP)
Parallel Redundancy Protocol (PRP)
(R)STP: (Rapid) Spanning Tree Protocol
Fast Ring Detection
Bridge Protocol Data Units (BPDUs)
correct_answer: (R)STP: (Rapid) Spanning Tree Protocol

question: How is a MAC address table updated in a bridge or switch? [IEEE 802.3]
options: By sending requests to all devices on the network
By copying all MAC addresses from the relevant segment of the network
By manually inputting MAC addresses
By listening to network traffic and discovering MAC addresses
correct_answer: By listening to network traffic and discovering MAC addresses

question: When is the minimum applicable scheduling offset restriction applied? [3GPP Release 17]
options: When the UE is scheduled with DCI format 0_1 or 1_1
When the DCI in slot n indicates an active DL (UL) BWP change
When there is an active DL BWP change in the scheduling cell
When the PDCCH reception includes two PDCCH candidates from two respective search space sets
When the 'Minimum applicable scheduling offset indicator' field is received outside the first three symbols of the slot
correct_answer: When the UE is scheduled with DCI format 0_1 or 1_1

question: How can UE power consumption due to false paging alarms be reduced? [3GPP Release 17]

By reducing PDCCH monitoring
By relaxing UE measurements for RLM and/or BFD
By providing TRS/CSI-RS occasions to idle/inactive-mode UEs
By dividing UEs into multiple subgroups

question: What is the purpose of using orthogonal hopping sequences in multiple 802.11 networks in a single area? [IEEE 802.11]
options: To ensure synchronization between the networks
To increase the number of available frequency slots
To maximize the coverage area of the networks
To minimize interference between the networks
correct_answer: To minimize interference between the networks

Service accessibility performance
Service retainability performance
Service integrity performance
All of the above

question: What is the primary purpose of a Modem in telecommunications?

To amplify Wi-Fi signals for better coverage.
To protect a network from cyber threats.
To manage network traffic and prioritize data packets.
correct_answer: To convert digital data to analog signals for transmission over telephone lines.

question: What is the role of the Online Charging System (OCS)?

To perform quota management and handle transactions

Presence of downlink buffered data for paged STAs and their assigned RAW slots

A unit of electrical amplitude
